title: refactor(components)!: retire ten zero-consumer shadcn sub-part entry exports
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XLrM5uzVJrXqe52zucmt8q9)_

Part of #25921

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none (none of the ten names appears under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`@object-ui/components` 的根入口不再导出 10 个 shadcn 子部件(`DialogPortal`、`DialogOverlay`、`DialogClose`、`DropdownMenuPortal`、`SheetPortal`、`SheetClose`、`SidebarSeparator`、`SidebarGroupAction`、`SidebarMenuBadge`、`SidebarMenuSkeleton`);这是 #25921 的第 14 批,形状同第 6 批 #30752。
- 为什么改:两个仓库里没有任何代码从包入口引用它们;包外仅有的同名文字是上游 shadcn registry 快照(各自声明自己的副本)和一处说 Radix 原语的注释。
- 风险与回滚:shadcn 模块文件一个字节不动,包内 `MobileDialogContent` 照常直接从 `../ui/dialog` 读两个部件;外部 npm 宿主若从入口 import 这些名字会编译失败(未实测,changeset 写了 BREAKING 与替代写法)。`!` patch,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/components/src/ui/index.ts`(四处 `export *` 改具名列表)、`.changeset/25921-components-shadcn-subparts.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`,预期十个名字都 `verified … (export, ui/packages/components/src/ui/…)`、退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Batch 14 as named in the seat's amendment 6714859776 on claim 6714776657 (census `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/ui/25921-b14-census.md`, `origin/main` `7c523aa1`, hotcrm `6961ab13`).

- **`ui/packages/components/src/ui/index.ts`** (the unpublished sub-barrel that `src/index.ts` star-exports): the `export *` lines for `./dialog`, `./dropdown-menu`, `./sheet` and `./sidebar` become named lists without the ten names. The four shadcn module files are unchanged (No-Touch, ui AGENTS #7); no module is deleted.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/25921-components-shadcn-subparts.md`: `!` patch, BREAKING, FROM/TO for each name, `runtime-export-retired` ×10 (FROM spans 1:1), both declaration lines.

Every other name of the four modules stays exported, among them `DialogContent`, `SheetOverlay`, `SheetContent`, every other `DropdownMenu*` part, `SidebarMenuAction`, `useSidebar` and `useOptionalSidebar`. `DrawerClose` stays too (seat ruling in 6714859776).

## Tests

- Census per name (`git grep -lw` on `origin/main` outside `ui/packages/components`): every hit is in `ui/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/{dialog,dropdown-menu,sheet,sidebar}.registry.txt`, the upstream snapshots that declare their own copies. `DialogPortal` also hits a comment in `ui/e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts` that names Radix's own part. hotcrm 0 for all ten. Positive controls, same command (files): `DialogContent` 67, `SheetContent` 29, `DropdownMenuItem` 87, `SidebarMenuButton` 14.
- In-package readers: only `src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx` reads `DialogPortal` and `DialogOverlay`, and it imports them from `../ui/dialog`, not through the sub-barrel.
- Reverse probe of the entry (TypeScript checker export list of `src/index.ts`): 364 names before, 354 after; exactly these ten gone, none added. Built `dist/index.js` imported at runtime: none of the ten is a key; the controls `DialogContent`, `SheetContent`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `SidebarMenuButton` and `DrawerClose` are.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/` → Test Files 477 passed | 1 skipped (478), Tests 4573 passed | 24 skipped. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` → exit 0.
- No test was added or removed, and there is no ablation: this only stops re-exporting ten names and changes no tested behaviour.

## Acceptance notes

- Left on the card: `DrawerClose` (its outside hits are JSX text in an eslint rule comment and its RuleTester fixture; seat ruling 6714859776), `MobileDialogContentProps` (a `custom/` Props type with zero hits, not the shadcn family), and the census's other notes (plugin-timeline primitives and fields' `index.tsx` values need a module move; react's `LazyPluginLoader` trio is taught by name in `content/docs/frontend/*` and `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md`).
